avis.titre: Wanted to love but ruined my skin
avis.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne for years now, but nothing besides some returning pimples that, looking back, were more of annoyance if anything. Having LOVED Mad Hippie's Vitamin C serum and recieving a sample of this Vitamin A serum within my package, I figured I'd give it a shot and see if this would be the miracle product the reviews claimed to be. Oh my, was I wrong. To be frank, I had experimented with the DHC cleansing oil a month prior which had given me horrible cystic pimples and a messed up barrier. I applied this serum every other night, alternating with The Ordinary Niacinamide serum on my "off" days. The first night I had a beautiful glow and my pimples seemed smaller. Every use after furthered a nightmare of my own design. My skin is so messed up even 4 months later; I cant use any actives (even my old products that never caused me ant issues) without my skin burning, becoming red and inflamed, or breaking out in terrible little whiteheads and even MORE cystic pimples on my jaw! The left side of my face is now covered in rough, bumpy skin that refuses to smooth over. I had high hopes for my first retinoid seeing as I had experince with AHA/BHAs, and that this formula was supposed to be gentle enough for people like me. So disappointing and I really miss the way my skin was before I used this serum. Buy at your own risk.
This stuff is the real deal. When I stop using it, I have acne. When I use it, I don't. Staple in my routine.
I use this on my off days of prescription retinol (I can use that only twice a week) and it works great as a gentle yet effective retinol.
I didn't realize how good this was until I tried another brand.

avis.texte: Been using for 3 weeks now and I really think it's been helping with my acne! Also, smells very nice. I will be purchasing again, especially if my face stays this clear!

avis.texte: I am using it 2 times a week. My skin tends to be sensative, I haven't had any issues with this product. My skin look and feels great! I am 69 years old and get compliments on my complexion!

I have noticed a significant difference in my skin! It's a necessity in my routine!
Mad Hippie is my favorite!! I love the super A serum!! The smell, how it feels on my face and the effects on my skin!!! If you haven't tried Mad Hippie products, you should!!!

avis.texte: Love the Super A Serum! It is not heavy and makes my skin glow. I feel like I look younger!!!
Just the right consistency, nice light fragrance and great results!

I got this from Ulta's beauty finds bags. I didn't expect much from an unknown to me brand, but now that I've used it all up and currently using something else, I can say I miss it very much. My skin just had this really nice glow and smoothness look to it. It's being added to my restock list now.

I am 44 and have difficult skin. Dry and sensitive with rosacea; prone to acne, and hyperpigmentation. I have also failed prescription topical retinoids at least 3 times, and thus had given up hope for the last 10 years that I would ever be able to use ANY kind of topical retinoid. Fast forward to now. I have been using the Super A serum for the last 20 days, sandwiched between a lightweight and heavier weight moisturizer, every evening. AND I AM BLOWN AWAY. The acne and congestion on my chin that has been a permanent fixture of my skin for as long as I can remember is virtually GONE. Up and vanished. Upon initiation I did have ONE "purge" which resulted in a very nasty cyst on my chin that took >2 weeks to resolve. But I pushed through and now it's in the clear and my skin has never looked better. I am looking forward to seeing what more this serum has in store. Updating at the 1 month point: I am gobsmacked. My skin is virtually flawless. To think, all this time, this serum was what I needed? It's a miracle.
Im in love with this product! I have very sensitive and acne prone skin, and this works great for me.
I bought this as an alternative to more expensive retinols that left my skin dry and bumpy. I love this product. I love that it has clean and effective ingredients.

I had a bad breakout a few months ago and this serum has really helped my skin. My skin feels smooth and looks more radiant. I noticed a difference with my skin texture and appearance after just a few days of using this. Its taken it a bit longer to clear up my acne, but after two months of consistent use my acne is so much better, I just had to be a little patient. I havent noticed a significant difference with dark spots yet, but I think after a little longer I will.

I'm 45. I've had to use benzoyl peroxide ever since I was a teen for pimples. I've tried a dozen other acne solutions over the past 30 years, as I hate the way BP stains my towels and sheets. I finally thought I'd give MadHippie products a try - bought the jelly cleanser, Vitamin C serum (day), Vitamin A serum (night), face moisturizer and eye cream. Things got ugly for a few weeks, but I'd read about "retinol purging" and determined to stick with it. Now, 5 weeks in, new pimple emergence is almost down to zero, forehead and cheek texture is smoother, and recent zits are healing and disappearing. I believe over the next week breakouts will stop completely. I am SO HAPPY. I love the way the products smell sweet and fresh just by virtue of their ingredients and not additional fragrances.
Enjoying the product so far in my rotation of nightly serums!

First of all I'm 76 years young. When I first read the reviews and thought this product is just for the younger set! Boy was I wrong! I've used Super A, the cleanser and Vitamin C and I'm hooked. My skin is great a friend recently said your skin is glowing! Thanks Mad Hippie!!

This serum changed my life! I struggled with hormonal breakouts and was using Curology (big mistake). I got an organic facial, and the tech recommended switching to plant-based organic A serums, so I tried this. I have not had a breakout since using it, and my skin texture has dramatically improved!! I will be using this serum for life!
I have no breakouts from using this. I have a really hard time finding things i can use without breaking out. So far everything I used from Mad Hippie has been good to my skin.

avis.titre: Glad I got to sample it
avis.texte: I received the 0.5 oz bottle in the Ulta Beauty Glow Into Spring bag and was excited because I did need a new retinol. It has a nice light citrus/floral scent and goes on not feeling to heavy. I haven't had any issues with peeling or sensitivity using it every other night, but I have used retinol before this so it's not new to my skin. Price-wise it's a good bang for your buck compared to the Cosrx oil I was using before. I do plan to repurchase this when I run out, maybe the larger size.

avis.titre: Nice compromise to the higher end serums
avis.texte: I (29F) was hestiant at first before buying it. I use it after every face wash then gently either massage in my skin or use my Rose Wiartz roller. The smell has nice light scent smell. Reminds me of a Burt's Bees smell. It helps smooth my skin and gives me a nice refresh face. I have semi-sensitive skin so it's also nice for that.

avis.titre: A little Goes A Long Way
avis.texte: I got a little sample packet with my order today, I squeezed some out, not knowing how it will feel on my face, I think I could have gotten a few nights worth in it, a little does go a long way, when I get the bottle of this i ll be using it a little more sparingly, great product though, can't wait for results!
This is the first retinoid that didn't freak my skin out. No flaking, no burning, no weird purging phase. My texture has seriously improved and my makeup sits so much better now
I've used this and the Triple C night cream for years. Love Mad Hippie products

avis.titre: really helped with my acne and dull skin
avis.texte: I'm in my thirties with very dry skin, have had acne since my early teens. I tried the AHA glycolic acid serum first, which made my skin pretty soft but didn't resolve my acne. I saw an immediate difference when I switched to the Super A serum. I started with every other night and now apply every night along with a salicylic acid gel. My acne has decreased significantly and my skin tone is more even and bright. Over the years I've tried Proactiv, Curology, and various natural remedies for acne but this is the one that's working for me now as my skin ages.

I finally asked my dermatologist for a recommendation (don't know why I didn't ask sooner) and she recommended this product and I am so grateful. It's gentle enough that I was able to ramp up to nightly use super quickly, but also effective. avis.titre: Already seeing results after a weeks use.
avis.texte: I picked this serum up at Ulta because I have some acne scars on my chin. I have been using this serum every night, and my skin already looks healthier. It appears more radiant and smooth. Mind you, it's only been a week so imagine what my skin will look like after a months use.

I got this as part of a free gift sample size, gave it a try just to see if I noticed anything. Went to work a few days later and a coworker said my skin was glowing and looked amazing. I've noticed a big difference in the brightness of my face and it seems like it has even helped with acne. I'll definitely be buying it again!

avis.titre: Perfect formula - plz make a jumbo size

Where as the standard Vitamin A I could use night after night with no issues. I like that Bakuchiol is part of the formula. For the price and results, it's worth keeping in my routine along with various other brands of retinol/vitamin A.
I have a really good complexion anyways bit this has given my skin a glow. Love it.

Thanks to Amy for sending a sample to try and always giving helpful advice !!

I have been using this nightly for about two weeks with a moisturizer. My skin is already visibly brighter, smoother, and my under eye puffiness is much less!! I am tolerating this without the side effects, making me think that this brand is cleaner and free of chemicals and was not the retinol? I am amazed.

I have been using Mad Hippie products (I have most of their product line and use them religiously) for a few years now and my skin looks more healthy and beautiful at 44 years old than it did in my 20's and 30's!! My 14 year old son has been suffering with acne for about a year now he was completely covered in acne on his forehead and sides of if his face for the last couple of months. I don't break out anymore so I didnt think about using my products on his face but I had ordered a line that claimed it would clear him up but all he got was an allergic reaction to it (2 weeks ago) and his face looked the worse it ever has so I started reading reviews on the Vitamin A and seen it was clearing acne. I started using my Vitamin A on him at night and my Vitamin C serum on him in the morning on 12/20/23 and holy cow it's unbelievable how much it has cleared his face in a week nore than half of his acne is gone and I can literally see new gorgeous skin where it has cleared up! I knew these products were the best out there in my opinion but I am seriously blown away with the results on my sons skin! Our next step was going to the dermatologist and we are both happy that it is clearing up and won't have to. I recommend all of Mad Hippie products to everyone. I haven't worn foundation in a couple of years since I found Mad Hippie, I just use Tartes BB cream and my skin is flawless!!

I have to leave a review for the old Vitamin A serum because that was amazing and I can't wait to try the Super A when I run out of my bottle of the old Vitamin A. It's has done wonders on my skin my 14 year old son has been battling acne on his forehead and side of his face and I'm talking covered in acne it was so terrible I was getting ready to take him to a dermatologist. I started using the Vitamin A serum at night on him and the Vitamin C serum in the morning on him last week and more than half of his acne has cleared up and I can see healed gorgeous skin! I was amazed at what it has done for my skin being in my 40's but I am absolutely blown away watching what it is doing for my son's face. Please never stop making your products they are truly amazing and I recommend them to everyone willing to listen. I am so passionate about Mad Hippie!!
After trying the vitamin A for 6 months, my wrinkles are fading , worth the money. I will keep using this. Recommended.

This stuff is SO amazing, I struggled with acne a lot and this completely cleared all my pimples. I've tried a lot of acne forward products but this one did really good for me, I think even if you don't have acne it just really helps with breakouts. Will definitely be buying again.

This is my favorite product in the Mad Hippie line. It smells amazing, has wonderful consistency, absorbs easily, and makes my skin look and feel amazing. If I had to choose just one product from the line to use, this would be it.
I love this vitamin a serum! It smells nice, i like the eye dropper bottle, and it absorbs faurly quickly into the skin. I love the clean brand in general
I use this in the evening and the Vit C in the morning and am very pleased with the results. I used to use Philosophy and this works much better for me.

I can't necessarily give the complete review of this since i was only giving a tiny sample of this, however I really liked of it felt on my skin. Vit A is well known for doing wonders for the skin so I'm confident this product does what it claims to do!

This product was recommended to me by a family member. I was suffering from breakouts and small pimples/bumps all over face. I have been using this at night in combination with the Vitamin C serum for less than a week and notice a dramatic difference. My skin looks smoother, clearer, and brighter. The Vitamin A helped push out old blackheads and congested pores. Absolutely love this product!

With in the first 2 weeks of use I felt like I was seeing positive results with nightly use. Then I started to get the retinizing rash around my lower eyelid and upper cheeks, that is somewhat expected with a retinoid product (especially an active one such as this) but can be avoided if used wisely. I took a break from this for about a week to let it heal. Going back in I'm going to titrate more gradually, so skip 2 nights between applications for 2 weeks, then every other night for another 2 weeks, then hopefully but then I could resume nightly use. I knocked of 1 star because of the orange oil. Sweet orange is not as irritating as most other citrus, it's probably the most mild of the citrus oils, but still generally it can be irritating. Retinoids are already inherently irritating for a newbie so it makes no sense to add this additional potential irritant. I don't think it adds anything to the formulation. It would still be a very elegant product, perhaps even more so without any fragrance. I would repurchase this but I'm also on the look out for similar products that are fragrance-free.

I was gifted this product and was unsure if It actually did anything. It feels amazing when you put It on and feel the firming of your skin. It does have a slight smell (i think It smells good but I know not everybody enjoys that) Over time I can really see a change in my skin and love the way It feels! I have very dry skin and It feels more hydrated and reduced appearance of wrinkles.

I received a sample of this product a year ago and I can honestly say I cannot live without it now. This product is PHENOMENAL! I tend to break out often and get a lot of blemishes that leave dark spots on my face. The minute I put this on my face, within 2 days my face clears up. I have combination skin and I use it in combination with my regular moisturizer. It's by far one of the top 3 products I have ever used. It leaves my skin smooth, clear, looking healthy and bright. I never write reviews but definitely felt this product deserved one. Don't think about it and just try it. You won't regret it.

Holy Grail!! I have been using a high end retinol for the last year!! Very minimal results. I introduced this Vitamin A serum into my routine about 3 weeks ago. I noticed lately that I was going out with no makeup, more often. And that my skin was very plump and brightened. I knew immediately that it was the Vitamin A!! This stuff works!!! Don't hesitate BUY it!!! Loving the results!!

If you're like me with patches of psoriasis, I cannot recommend this enough! This stuff has helped minimize the appearance of my psoriasis a great deal and at times completely, just depends on how much stress I have going on. While the only downside is that you have to wait 10 minutes until you can apply your moisturizer it is definitely worth it. Just be sure to use sunscreen the following day, and start slow with adding it into your nighttime routine.

I was given a sample with my Vitamin C serum and this is quality stuff. It goes on clean, my skin appears more even just a few days later. It has a scent but it's not perfume. More like apple. It can be like a retinol substitute serum, I will purchase.

avis.texte: I am over 40 and have non cancerous sun damage that is rough to the touch. Dermatologists freeze it off but it never fully smooths and always comes right back. I've been using this Vitamin A serum for about a month now, and have been loving the results. The sun damage on my face is smoothing out, and my complexion is becoming more balanced. Bothersome fine lines around my mouth and chin are smoothing out. Follow the directions - it does take the skin some getting used to at first. I have sensitive skin.

This is absolutely my favorite product I've ever used. I used to fall for gimmicky products and never wanted to spend the money on a product that actually worked. This serum 10000% does what it is intended to and has made my skin so healthy and it has started to glow instead of its typical dry appearance. 100% worth the money
I love this line of products. Very light, no weird fragrance and great results.

avis.titre: I will always buy this product!
avis.texte: I cannot yep you enough how much this has helped my 41 year old skin. I have used many vitamin a products in the past and never gotten these results! What a win!

avis.titre: Do yourself a favor and get it.
avis.texte: I never write product reviews for anything but felt the need for this serum because it has made such a huge difference in my skin in only like a week. I have sebaceous filaments on my forehead and elsewhere on my face and was googling what to use naturally or store bought until I can get into the Derm to have them removed, and saw that vitamin A worked. So I ended up buying this at Ulta. WAY cheaper than other vitamin A serums I saw online, i've already tried your vitmamin C serum and loved it. I've used in nightly under my night cream and it leaves my skin so soft, clear, shrinking my pores, evening skin tone, I also suffer from acnitic keratosis on my forehead and this is making it go away which I cannot believe. I love this stuff thank you!

avis.titre: Not for everyone, Can be irritating
avis.texte: I have oily skin and enlarged pores. I used this to address some sun damage on my forehead, but every time I would use this at night, I woke up the next day with reactive skin. It felt a little tight, kind of like a sunburn. The oil would be gone and the skin smooth, but after I would cleanse my skin would go into sebum overdrive, producing too much oil that day to fix what was stripped away. I didn't use it every night, it was every other night and my skin still couldn't take it. I would just caution you to pay attention to what your skin is trying to tell you and discontinue use if needed.

I have eczema, and my skin is allergic to basically everything. This serum is wonderful - it's gentle and calming, and leaves my face feeling comfortable (as opposed to itchy and on fire like with most facial products, even the ones that are supposed to be for sensitive skin). I'm not so concerned about wrinkles or aging; I just love how this product makes my face stop hurting. I've been using it for over a year, and have never had a bad reaction. I use it sparingly, maybe once a week or so, and I still think it makes a big difference.
If you have any issues with large pores this is what you need it will fix your pores in the first week of using it. Game changer

avis.titre: Loved the product to begin with but!!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this product and add it to my vegan skincare routine. I absolutely loved using this for a number of weeks but after that i had to stop using it as the product seemed the have spoilt and had a rather off putting odor. I may try this product again in the future.
I started using this only a week ago and my skin has transformed entirely. I never really saw results with Vitamin C serums and this the perfect serum to add to my daily routine.

avis.titre: Been using Mad Hippie products for years.
avis.texte: Mad Hippie is my fav. Been using for years. My 69 year old face looks at least 10 years younger I've been told.

I am 30 years old, have sensitive skin, and I use this every night after washing my face and prior to moisturizer! This stuff feels so good on the skin, makes my skin feel soft & supple, and after using it I do feel that my face appears softer, smoother, & youthful. Definitely recommend trying to get a sample of this or getting this when it's on sale to try it out!
Have bought this over and over again! I love mad hippie products!

So I just started using this for about 1 week. I know everyone says this but when I say I have sensitive skin I mean the kind of skin that if you touch it with a finger it becomes red, blotchy, then basically shrivels up, dies, and flakes off. I'm not exaggerating. That being said, I have to be very very careful what I use on my skin. I began using this as instructed (every other night) and making sure to wait the ten minutes to apply my night cream. My skin is so clear and without redness that I'm alarmed. Should my skin look like this? Where is my rosacea ? What about my flakes on my forehead ? And did I mention that dark spots/post acne hyperpigmentation are starting to go away ? I'm floored. I'm hoping my skin doesn't start to react badly so here's to hoping.
It's so soft and soaks in. I think it's helping my aunt damaged skin! Sometimes I put it on in the middle of the day just to hydrate wrinkles.
This serum did nothing for my skin. It claims to have Vit A, but it does not work like Vit A. Waste do not buy this product.

I have been using this wrong. Make sure and read the bottle about waiting ten minutes. My younger sister says that she can tell a big difference in my skin. It didn't irritate my skin but I don't think it did anything to improve my skin, either. I've been waking up feeling like my skin looks tired and am not noticing the same "glow" I was getting after using the Cerave retinol product.

If the formula has changed - please consider going back to the original.
I love the feel, smell, quality of this. Retinol was too strong on my skin. This is perfect, giving me the same results with no breakout or peeling

avis.titre: If there was only one skincare item

got this because I wanted to get into retinol but wanted to build up my skins defense first. this made my skin so soft evened my skin tone fast and skins soooo good.been using for less than a month and already see results.
Very first product I used by mad hippie. So glad I did. I love the whole line. This product helps my skin glow! All the actives have done wonders for my skin with nightly use.
Leaves your face so smooth and radiant! Seriously, buy this! It's magical.

I love this Vitamin A serum! It helps me with my anti-aging worries, and my skin is insanely soft. I urge people to speak to their doctor first before taking this advice, but my OBGYN even OKed this while I was pregnant, so that was a HUGE bonus.

avis.titre: Where was this product when I was a teen?
avis.texte: I used toner, serums, vitamin A, moisturizer and then oil at night. Toner, vitamin c, moisturizer and sunscreen in the morning

Really wanted to love this. I had high hopes for this one but unfortunately it broke me out really badly. I thought maybe if I stuck with it my skin would adapt, but after a couple weeks of nonstop breakouts I finally gave up and threw it away.

avis.titre: The Serum I Didn't Know I Needed
avis.texte: I hadn't heard of Vitamin A, and was intimidated by the thought of it being a chemical exfoliant (sounds frightening!) After using this and feeling my skin after, I'm so glad I tried it. My fault for not reading the ingredient list before buying. Returned.
Wanted to love this. Smelled so good, felt great, but broke me out.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: Does not irritate the skin and use it every night without irritation.

I've been using this for about 2 months and my skin looks better than it has in years. I'm 44 years old. I have very sensitive combination skin that breaks out very easily.
